summary: #poemsofpresence I follow your shadows. footprints too heavy for me to carry slipping past trail markers hanging, you carry on amongst spring growth clinging to rock flowing to the lake shore. life carries on, no matter who leads
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#poemsofpresence

I follow
     your
shadows.
footprints
  too heavy for me to
carry
slipping past
trail markers
hanging, you
carry
 on
amongst
spring
growth
clinging to rock
flowing to the
lake shore.
   life
carries
on,
no matter who
leads
